JOB DESCRIPTION:
Global Medical Director – Gastroenterology

Abbott | Established Pharmaceutical Division

About Abbott

At Abbott , we believe people live their fullest lives when they are healthy — physically, emotionally, and socially . As a global healthcare leader with more than 107,000 colleagues across 160+ countries , we develop life‑changing medicines and technologies that support health at every stage of life.

Within our Branded Generics business, we make trusted, high‑quality medicines accessible to more than 18 million people every day , particularly in fast‑growing regions such as LATAM, APAC, India, and Emerging Markets . Our diverse portfolio spans critical therapeutic areas including Women’s Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory , addressing real and often unmet patient needs worldwide.

Abbott is a place where science, purpose, and people come together — and where diverse perspectives and inclusive leadership are essential to delivering better outcomes for patients globally.
Your Impact

As Global Medical Director – Gastroenterology , you will play a central role in shaping Abbott’s global medical strategy for the GI therapeutic area. Working closely with cross‑functional partners, you will help define short‑ and long‑term direction , ensuring medical decision‑making is scientifically robust, patient‑centered, and aligned with global and local needs.

You will be a core member of the Medical Affairs Leadership Team within the Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD), contributing your expertise and perspective to strategic decisions across Medical Affairs and Innovation & Development.

What You Will Do

Medical Strategy & Scientific Leadership

• Lead the global medical strategy and activities for the Gastroenterology therapeutic area and assigned products

• Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to translate scientific insight into meaningful medical and patient impact

• Identify unmet medical needs and mid‑ to long‑term opportunities for differentiation, innovation, and value creation

• Continuously evaluate products within scope, identifying portfolio gap‑filling opportunities , including in‑licensing considerations

• Develop therapeutic area medical plans , integrating research priorities, publication strategies, real‑world evidence, and study initiatives

• Prepare Target Product Profiles (TPPs) in partnership with cross‑functional teams

• Drive scientific excellence by reviewing medical literature and generating differentiated ideas (including digital) to strengthen disease management and patient care

Evidence Generation & Governance

• Lead and govern Global Medical Affairs research projects , including IIS, post‑marketing studies, observational and epidemiologic research, Phase IV and RWE studies

• Serve as a member of the Scientific Review Committee , jointly reviewing and approving clinical activities led by Clinical Development

• Ensure high‑quality medical content for digital initiatives aimed at both HCPs and patients

Collaboration, Safety & Compliance

• Build and maintain strong collaboration with regional and local Medical Directors , ensuring alignment between global strategy and local execution

• Establish and sustain trusted, ethical relationships with Key Opinion Leaders and scientific societies

• Act as a core member of the Product Safety Team , overseeing medical safety monitoring and contributing to PSURs, clinical overviews, and risk‑management plans

• As part of the Labeling Sub‑Team , provide medical input and scientific strategies for global and national label changes, including safety‑related updates

• Ensure that all medical and promotional activities comply with global guidelines and regulatory requirements

People Leadership

• Lead and develop a team of two direct reports , fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high‑performing environment

• Attract, mentor, and retain talent through servant leadership , coaching, and emp

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Medical Educator - Romandie

Abbott Diabetes Care est un leader mondial dans le domaine de la gestion du diabète et s’engage à permettre aux personnes atteintes de diabète de mener une vie plus saine et plus épanouie. Grâce à une innovation continue et à un engagement constant envers la qualité, Abbott propose des systèmes de surveillance du glucose de pointe, notamment la célèbre gamme de produits FreeStyle Libre™ . Ces produits fournissent des valeurs de glucose précises et fiables et aident les patients ainsi que les professionnels de santé à mieux gérer le diabète.
La mission d’Abbott est de faire progresser en permanence la prise en charge du diabète grâce à des technologies innovantes et à un accompagnement durable, pour obtenir les meilleurs résultats de santé possibles à l’échelle mondiale.

Le/la Medical Educator est un poste terrain, orienté vers les professionnels de santé (HCPs), au sein d’Abbott Diabetes Care en Suisse. Sa mission principale consiste à fournir une expertise médico-scientifique en diabétologie et à assurer des formations médicales de haute qualité sur les technologies de surveillance du glucose par capteur (FreeStyle Libre™) en Suisse.
L’objectif central du poste est de soutenir les équipes de traitement du diabète afin qu’elles puissent tirer pleinement parti des systèmes CGM pour leurs populations de patients. Le rôle inclut également la transmission crédible d’informations scientifiques ainsi que le dialogue professionnel avec les acteurs de santé dans la zone géographique attribuée.
Le poste requiert une collaboration étroite et conforme avec les équipes commerciales, tout en garantissant une indépendance médicale totale et une intégrité scientifique maximale.

Vos responsabilités

• Fournir une expertise médico-scientifique en diabétologie pour soutenir les produits FreeStyle Libre™ en Suisse ; collaborer de manière transversale pour développer, aligner et mettre en œuvre des stratégies et programmes au niveau des clients dans votre secteur

• Créer et présenter des exposés scientifiques et médicaux destinés aux professionnel·le·s de santé , individuellement ou en groupe, en présentiel, en ligne ou sous forme enregistrée

• Effectuer des visites terrain auprès des HCPs et échanger sur des sujets médico-scientifiques pertinents sur la base des données scientifiques disponibles

• Planifier, coordonner et animer des programmes internes de formation et de perfectionnement sur des sujets médico-scientifiques

• Réaliser des tâches médico-scientifiques internes (par ex. validations, évaluations de Fair Market Value, activités CRM B2B) ainsi qu’un support administratif

• Développer et entretenir un réseau comprenant sociétés savantes, leaders d’opinion (KOLs), médecins et autres professionnel·le·s de santé pertinents

• Collaborer avec les équipes Medical Affairs d’ADC en DACH, EMEAP et au niveau global

• Organiser des programmes médico-scientifiques pour des congrès locaux, y compris la réalisation de présentations spécialisées

• Soutenir la sélection et la mise en œuvre d’éléments et d’événements spécifiques de la FreeStyle Academy™

Vos qualifications

• Professionnel de santé reconnu (par ex. éducateur en diabète, diététicien ou médecin) avec une solide expérience clinique dans la prise en charge des personnes atteintes de diabète

• Expérience dans l’industrie pharmaceutique ou des dispositifs médicaux

• Réseau établi dans le domaine de la diabétologie en Suisse

• Capacité démontrée à travailler de manière proactive et orientée solutions

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et en gestion de projet

• Forte aisance digitale et compréhension technique

• Esprit d’équipe associé à créativité et autonomie

• Capacité à collaborer de manière transversale et à évoluer efficacement dans une organisation matricielle

• Maîtrise du français, de l’allemand et de l’anglais (selon la région), l’italien étant un atout

• Forte mobilité (environ 80 %, poste terrain)

Poursuivez

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader committed to helping people live their fullest lives at every stage. With a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, medical devices, nutrition, and branded generic medicines, our 114,000 colleagues serve patients in over 160 countries, driving innovation that advances health worldwide.

Within Abbott’s Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD), we are expanding our Women’s Health team and are seeking an experienced Global Medical Manager – Women’s Health to support our continued growth.

In this global role, you will partner closely with regional and affiliate Medical teams, Innovation & Development, and Global Marketing, reporting directly to the Global Medical Director of Women’s Health.

Main Responsibilities

• Responsible for specific activities and strategic projects within Medical Affairs for the Women`s Health Portfolio

• Support the Global Medical Director in reviewing, approving and overviewing global and regional medical / clinical studies and publications relevant to the therapeutic area

• In close collaboration with the Global and Regional Marketing Teams, plan and execute prelaunch activities of cross-regional products/brands

• With collaboration of regional medical teams run Key Opinion Leader assessment and identification projects, organize Key Opinion Leaders database, ensure regular updates, identify potential global Key Opinion Leaders, and inform internal stakeholder on potential global Key Opinion Leader candidates

• Work on medical maintenance of global brands by participating in product safety team meetings, Labeling team meetings, writing and/or reviewing scientific documents, updating product scientific library, etc.

• Collaborating with marketing team on developing promotional materials, including sales aids, web pages, digital platforms, etc. and ensuring scientific validity of the contents

• For geo-expansion of local products, update/upgrade scientific part of registration dossiers in order to get them into approvable standards in other countries.

• Conduct medical assessments on new Licensing & Acquisition opportunities for portfolio expansion

The profile

• Medical Doctor degree and/or PhD in related life sciences with relevant pharmaceutical industry experience in regional or global roles

• At least 5 years of regional or global responsibility for comparable products

• Clinical research experience is an additional merit

• Operating within and cross-functional international /global geographic area

• Strong project management skills across several functional areas

• First international experience, especially in emerging markets is a plus

• Willing to work hands on and be able to think strategically at the same time

• Strong organizational skills, able to communicate on different levels and used to adapt in rapidly changing environment

• Very good English language skills are required, any other language would be an asset

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

The Opportunity
The position works out of our Basel, Switzerland location at the global Headquarters of our medicines business. Our medicines business (Established Pharmaceuticals) is committed to bringing the benefits of our trusted medicines to more people in the world’s fastest-growing countries. Our broad portfolio of high-quality and differentiated branded generic medicines reaches across multiple therapeutic areas including gastroenterology, women's health, cardiometabolic, pain management/central nervous system, and respiratory.

As Senior HR Analyst – People & Workforce Analytics , you’ll have the chance to work with our global enterprise People Analytics team across multiple countries and regions. In this high-impact role, you will transform workforce data into actionable insights that help leaders make smarter talent and organizational decisions.

Working closely with HR leaders, HR Directors, HR Business Partners, and business stakeholders, you will combine advanced analytics , data storytelling , and consultative problem-solving to drive workforce strategy and business outcomes.

• Deliver data-driven workforce insights across key people metrics, translating complex analyses into clear recommendations that inform strategic decision-making

• Incorporate external benchmarks and labor market insights to contextualize workforce analytics findings

• Connect analytical outputs to strategic workforce priorities such as workforce planning, Scenario modelling, and HR investment decisions

Qualifications

• Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets in cloud environments

• Proficiency in Python and/or R for analytics and statistical modeling

• Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Structural Heart Business Mission:
Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life through the design and provision of device and management solutions for the treatment of structural heart disease.

Abbott's Structural Heart division in Switzerland is looking for a

Country Manager Structural Heart Switzerland
based in Switzerland

The Opportunity
The Country Manager Structural Heart Switzerland is responsible for maximizing revenue growth, profitability, and market penetration across Abbott's Structural Heart business in Switzerland. This leadership role owns the country P&L and is accountable for delivering top-line sales performance, managing operating expenses in line with budget expectations, and leading a high-performing commercial organization.
The Country Manager will develop and execute strategic growth plans, strengthen relationships with key customers and healthcare stakeholders, and ensure organizational excellence through effective leadership, talent development, and operational execution. Working closely with regional and global partners, this individual will position Abbott as the partner of choice in Structural Heart therapies while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, ethics, and patient focus.

• Develop and execute country business plans designed to achieve sales growth, profitability objectives, and market share expansion.

• Define and implement sales strategies and tactical plans to maximize market penetration across the Structural Heart portfolio.

• Own and manage all aspects of the country P&L, ensuring achievement of revenue, profitability, and expense objectives.

• Monitor SG&A expenditures and variable selling costs to optimize business performance and profit margins.

• Identify, assess, and capitalize on market opportunities while proactively managing business risks.

• Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team that consistently delivers against operating plans and strategic objectives.

• Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer focus.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with physicians, hospital administrators, healthcare stakeholders, key opinion leaders, and professional organizations.

• Ensure Abbott maintains a strong presence and reputation within the Swiss Structural Heart market.

• Partner with regional and global stakeholders to align local execution with broader business strategies.

• Drive effective resource allocation and organizational effectiveness to maximize business performance.

• Take proactive actions to improve operational efficiency and minimize unnecessary costs.

• Ensure full compliance with Abbott policies, quality standards, industry regulations, and local legal requirements.

• Serve as a role model for Abbott's values and Code of Conduct in all business interactions.

• Represent Abbott at customer meetings, industry events, scientific congresses, and professional forums.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

• Significant commercial leadership experience within the medical device, healthcare, cardiovascular, or related industry.

• Demonstrated experience managing revenue growth and business performance within a complex healthcare environment.

• Proven track record of developing and executing successful sales strategies and commercial plans.

• Experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing sales and commercial teams.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess market dynamics, identify opportunities, and mitigate risks.

Global Associate Director, Patient Strategy & Partnerships

Abbott | Established Pharmaceuticals Division

Make a Meaningful Difference for Patients Worldwide

At Abbott , we believe people can live fuller lives through better health. Every day, our medicines and technologies help millions of people around the world manage health conditions, overcome barriers to care, and achieve better outcomes.

Within our Branded Generics business, we provide trusted, high-quality medicines to more than 18 million people daily across Latin America, Asia-Pacific, India, and other emerging markets. Our portfolio spans areas including Women's Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic Health, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory Care , helping address some of healthcare's most pressing needs.

We are looking for a collaborative, purpose-driven leader to help strengthen the voice of patients across our organization and create meaningful partnerships that improve patient experiences and outcomes globally.
About the Opportunity

As Global Associate Director, Patient Strategy & Partnerships , you will play a key role in shaping how Abbott listens to, learns from, and collaborates with patients and patient organizations around the world.
This is a unique opportunity to build and evolve a global patient engagement capability, connecting patient insights with strategic decision making across Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory Affairs, Public Affairs, and Commercial teams.

You will work with colleagues across regions and functions to ensure patient perspectives help inform healthcare solutions, policy discussions, evidence generation, and access initiatives. Most importantly, you will help create lasting partnerships that improve outcomes for patients and communities.

What You'll Do

Shape Abbott's Global Patient Strategy

• Develop and advance a patient-centered engagement strategy across the organization

• Help integrate patient perspectives into business, medical, and access decisions

• Advise senior stakeholders on evolving patient needs, healthcare trends, and opportunities to improve patient experiences

• Promote patient trust as a cornerstone of responsible healthcare leadership

Build Meaningful Partnerships

• Develop and nurture relationships with patient organizations, advocacy groups, and patient leaders

• Create long-term collaborations around education, support programs, evidence generation, and healthcare improvement initiatives

• Foster trust-based partnerships that create shared value for patients and healthcare systems

Bring Patient Insights into Action

• Establish approaches to gather and translate patient insights into meaningful recommendations

• Partner with Medical Affairs and Market Access teams to ensure patient experiences inform evidence generation and value-based initiatives

• Help strengthen understanding of real-world patient challenges and outcomes

Support Advocacy and Healthcare System Improvement

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders on patient-centered policy and advocacy initiatives

• Contribute to discussions that improve access to care and reduce barriers to treatment

• Help elevate the patient voice within healthcare ecosystems globally

Drive Excellence and Capability Building

• Develop frameworks, guidance, and best practices for patient engagement across Abbott

• Champion patient-centered ways of working across teams and regions

• Support colleagues in building capabilities and confidence in patient partnership approaches

Act as an Ambassador for Patient-Centered Healthcare

• Represent Abbott at industry meetings, scientific congresses, and patient advocacy forums

• Help strengthen Abbott's reputation as a trusted partner within the patient community

• Share insights and best practices that advance patient engagement across the broader healthcare landscape

What You'll Bring

We're interested in individuals who are passionate about improving patient outcomes

Directeur associé mondial, Stratégie des patients et partenariats

Abbott. Division des produits pharmaceutiques

Faire une différence significative pour les patients du monde entier

Chez Abbott, nous croyons que les gens peuvent vivre plus pleinement grâce à une meilleure santé. Chaque jour, nos médicaments et nos technologies aident des millions de personnes dans le monde à gérer les conditions de santé, à surmonter les obstacles aux soins et à obtenir de meilleurs résultats.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un chef de file collaboratif et axé sur l'objectif pour aider à renforcer la voix des patients dans notre organisation et créer des partenariats significatifs qui améliorent les expériences et les résultats des patients à l'échelle mondiale.

Former la Stratégie mondiale des patients d'Abbott

• Conseiller les principaux intervenants sur l'évolution des besoins des patients, les tendances en matière de soins de santé et les possibilités d'améliorer l'expérience des patients

• Promouvoir la confiance des patients comme pierre angulaire d'un leadership responsable en matière de soins de santé

Construire des partenariats significatifs

• Développer et entretenir des relations avec des organisations de patients, des groupes de défense des intérêts et des chefs de file de patients

• Créer des collaborations à long terme sur l'éducation, les programmes de soutien, la production de données probantes et les initiatives d'amélioration des soins de santé

• Favoriser des partenariats fondés sur la confiance qui créent une valeur partagée pour les patients et les systèmes de santé

• Partenariat avec les équipes des Affaires médicales et de l'Accès au marché pour s'assurer que les expériences des patients éclairent la production de preuves et les initiatives fondées sur la valeur

• Aider à mieux comprendre les défis et les résultats réels des patients

Soutenir la défense et l'amélioration du système de santé

JOB DESCRIPTION:
At Abbott, we're committed to helping people live their best possible life through the power of health. For more than 125 years, we've brought new products and technologies to the world in nutrition, diagnostics, medical devices and branded generic pharmaceuticals that create more possibilities for more people at all stages of life. Today, 114,000 of us are working to help people live not just longer, but better, in the more than 160 countries we serve.

Abbott’s Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD) is looking to recruit a

Senior Director, Head of Global Marketing (m/f/d)

Based at the EPD HQ in Basel, Switzerland

Primary Job Function:

• Lead, define, and orchestrate the global marketing vision, strategy, and execution for Abbott’s Established Pharmaceuticals Division (EPD), driving sustainable above-market growth, enterprise value creation, and long-term competitive advantage across a multi-billion-dollar, multi-therapeutic portfolio spanning 80+ markets.

• As the most senior marketing leader in the organization, this role is accountable for shaping the end-to-end commercial strategy across all therapeutic areas, integrating portfolio strategy, brand building, innovation, digital ecosystems, and go-to-market excellence into a single, coherent growth engine. The Head of Global Marketing ensures the organization consistently outperforms competitors by embedding a data-driven, insight-led, and patient-centric approach across the full value chain from early portfolio ideation through lifecycle management and in-market execution.

• This role serves as a key strategic partner to Executive Leadership, influencing enterprise-wide priorities, resource allocation, and long-range planning, while building a high-performance global marketing organization capable of delivering transformational impact at scale.

Core Job Responsibilities:

Enterprise Marketing Strategy & Leadership

• Define and lead the overarching global marketing and commercial strategy across all therapeutic areas, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives and long-term growth ambitions.

• Architect and continuously evolve the company’s global brand and portfolio strategy, ensuring clear prioritization, competitive differentiation, and optimal resource allocation.

• Translate market dynamics, competitive intelligence, and customer insights into actionable enterprise strategies that drive above-market growth and market share leadership.

Portfolio & Innovation Leadership

• Lead the integration of marketing with I&D, Business Development, and Portfolio Expansion to define “where to play” and “how to win” across short-, mid-, and long-term horizons.

• Drive the identification, evaluation, and commercialization of new growth opportunities, including in-licensing, partnerships, and lifecycle innovation.

• Ensure a robust, future-ready portfolio by embedding commercial excellence into development decisions and accelerating time-to-market for new assets.

Global Brand & Launch Excellence

• Drive breakthrough creativity in all global brand campaigns and instil the need & processes to ensure that this translates through to local brands and local brand execution.

• Establish and govern global brand positioning, architecture, and communication strategies across all therapeutic areas and product categories.

• Oversee the design and execution of best-in-class global launch strategies, ensuring consistent excellence and rapid scalability across affiliates.

• Ensure all marketing programs are differentiated, insight-driven, and effectively deployed through multi-channel engagement models.

Commercial Execution & Affiliate Impact

• Drive execution excellence across regions and affiliates by setting clear strategic direction, performance targets, and governance frameworks.

• Review, challenge, and align affiliate commercial plans to ensure full consistency with global strategies and portfolio imperatives.

• Questo ruolo funge da partner strategico chiave per la leadership esecutiva, influenzando le priorità a livello aziendale, l'allocazione delle risorse e la pianificazione a lungo termine, mentre la costruzione di un'organizzazione di marketing globale ad alte prestazioni in grado di fornire impatto trasformazionale su scala.

Responsabilità principali del lavoro:

Strategia di marketing aziendale e leadership

• Definire e guidare la strategia globale di marketing e commerciale in tutte le aree terapeutiche, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali e le ambizioni di crescita a lungo termine.

• Architetto e evolve continuamente la strategia globale del brand e del portafoglio dell’azienda, garantendo una chiara priorità, una differenziazione competitiva e un’allocazione ottimale delle risorse.

• Traduci le dinamiche di mercato, l'intelligenza competitiva e le intuizioni dei clienti nelle strategie aziendali attuabili che guidano la crescita del mercato e la leadership delle quote di mercato.

Portfolio & Innovation Leadership

• Condurre l’integrazione del marketing con I&D, Business Development e Portfolio Expansion per definire “dove giocare” e “come vincere” attraverso orizzonti a breve, a metà e a lungo termine.

• Guidare l'identificazione, la valutazione e la commercializzazione di nuove opportunità di crescita, tra cui in-licenziamento, partnership e l'innovazione del ciclo di vita.

• Assicurare un portafoglio robusto e pronto per il futuro incorporando l'eccellenza commerciale nelle decisioni di sviluppo e accelerando il time-to-market per nuovi asset.

Eccellenza Global Brand & Launch

• Guidare la creatività innovativa in tutte le campagne di marca globali e istigare i processi e le necessità per garantire che questo si traduce attraverso i marchi locali e l'esecuzione del marchio locale.

• Stabilire e governare strategie globali di posizionamento del marchio, architettura e comunicazione in tutte le aree terapeutiche e categorie di prodotti.

• Superare la progettazione e l'esecuzione di strategie di lancio globali best-in-class, garantendo un'eccellenza coerente e una scalabilità rapida tra le affiliate.

• Assicurarsi che tutti i programmi di marketing siano differenziati, orientati alle intuizioni e utilizzati efficacemente attraverso modelli di fidanzamento multicanale.

Esecuzione commerciale e impatto affiliato

• Guida l'eccellenza dell'esecuzione in tutte le regioni e le affiliate impostando una chiara direzione strategica, obiettivi di performance e framework di governance.

• Recensione, sfida e allineare i piani commerciali della filiale per garantire la piena coerenza con le strategie globali e gli imperativi del portafoglio.

• Campione di un finale

About Abbott

At Abbott, we believe people live their fullest lives when they are healthy — physically, emotionally, and socially. As a global healthcare leader with over 107,000 colleagues in 160+ countries , we create lifechanging technologies that support health at every stage of life.

Within our Branded Generics business , we make trusted, high quality medicines accessible to more than 18 million people every day , particularly in fast growing regions such as LATAM, APAC, India, and Emerging Markets. Our diverse portfolio spans critical therapeutic areas including Women’s Health, Gastroenterology, Cardiometabolic, CNS & Pain, and Respiratory — addressing real, unmet patient needs worldwide.

Abbott is a place where science, purpose, and people come together — and where diverse perspectives are essential to building better outcomes for patients.

Primary Job Function:

• Responsible for Procurement, contracts, Negotiations, Supplier Relationship Management of all direct materials (API, Excipients) from EU.

• Lead and guide the team of procurement managers for developing category strategy, negotiating with vendors etc. to ensure that the strategic procurement objectives of PTO are met consistently.

• Managing a spend multimillion spend and over 100 global suppliers.

• Develop, Implement and Sustain the Procurement Management Strategy to fulfil growth as per LRP.

• Develop, drive supply market insight capability within the PTO to increase knowledge of supply market dynamics, composition, trends and gain a comprehensive understanding of the market landscape and business models from a macro and micro economic perspective covering Procurement.

• Monitor supply market dynamics across peer organizations also for benchmarking purposes.

• Use business insights to leverage opportunities. Ensure an effective communication process within PTO helping to create an informational advantage supporting strategic decision making.

• Responsible / Ownership for developing and implementing global supplier relationship strategies leveraging the informational advantage coming from the knowledge of supply market landscape and dynamics. Initiate, design and support to deliver specific strategic projects and initiatives considering all relevant financial, operational, qualitative and regulatory aspects.

• Stakeholder management leading up to DVP levels to get support and resources to enable execution for the category strategy.

• Ensure that impacts to operations driven by regulatory requirements are minimized and/or leveraged for competitive advantage

• Facilitate, communicate, lead the global supplier landscape design, implementation, optimization and integration of the flow of materials and the related financials.

• Drive annual performance improvements via strategy work and applicable metrics.

• Build up and maintain supplier relationship experience roadmap and ensure that processes meet and reflect EPD overall expectations.

• Focus on achieving LRP PTO related savings

• Leads in analysing of all Supplier Cost within EPD PTO in relation to global supplies.

• Recruit, mentor, train and develop relevant team members.

Strategic Orientation

• Forecast price trends, industry trends of all key materials (API, Excipients). Conduct predictive analysis and help devise long term and short-term procurement strategy (including e-procurement) in alignment with the larger EPD strategy to proactively support revenue and division margin growth (market beating growth), evolve a cost-efficient procurement function.

• Facilitate identification of supply chain risks associated with cost, supply, quality etc. by analysis of market trends, regulatory changes etc. to ensure consistency with the Business Continuity Plan.

• Understands and contributes to the business unit strategy, based on the specific business and technology expertise, and translates business strategy for category.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life.
